sources.title_en: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
sources.title_original: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
sources.summary: Local AI is becoming more useful by the token. As AI agents move from experiments into everyday development, increasingly capable open models are shrinking to fit on more devices, giving builders more to run locally. Coming this month, NVIDIA DGX Spark will be available with 64GB of unified memory from top manufacturer partners — Acer, […]
sources.summary_zh: 本機人工智慧正隨著每一個 Token 變得越來越有用。隨著 AI 代理從實驗走向日常開發，能力日益強大的開源模型正在縮小以適應更多裝置，讓建構者有更多工具可以在本機上執行。本月即將推出，配備 64GB 統一記憶體的 輝達 DGX Spark 將由頂級製造商夥伴宏碁等人提供，[……]
